logline: When hired thugs attack Juliana's medicinal garden, Alexander unleashes his combat training to effortlessly overpower them, extracting a shocking confession that unmasks Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 15's cliffhanger where Alexander confronted the three thugs in the moonlit garden while Juliana huddled injured on the ground.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot from behind Alexander's trench coat looking toward the three thugs standing across the trampled garden under the full moon.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander stands tall and unyielding, blocking the path to Juliana, while the Thug with Cap steps forward clutching an iron pipe.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap, his eyes wide and sneering with false bravado as his bald accomplice watches from behind.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Menacing, Goading)
events.content: "Move aside, soldier."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred, weathered face, his cold blue-grey eyes fixed intently on his opponent.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium shot of the Thug with Cap gripping his weapon with both hands and roaring into the night air.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Furious, Shouting)
events.content: "I said, move!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Alexander remaining completely motionless, his jaw clenched in stoic calm.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud against the ruined planter, clutching her bandaged hands to her chest in trembling fear.

events.label: JULIANA (Frightened, Whispering)
events.content: "Alexander..."

events.label: ALEXANDER (Calm, Protective)
events.content: "Stay behind me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium action shot as the Thug with Cap lunges forward with his weapon raised high.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Roaring)
events.content: "Aaargh!"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Thug with Cap staring in wide-eyed terror as Alexander grips the bar and wrenches it away effortlessly.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana watching in breathless astonishment.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium tracking shot as the Bald Thug charges in with a shout, only for Alexander to pivot and seize him by the neck, hurling him across the garden path.

events.label: BALD THUG (Yelling)
events.content: "Aaargh!"

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Third Thug backing away nervously, raising a blunt rod with trembling arms before lunging.

events.label: THIRD THUG (Desperate, Shouting)
events.content: "Stay back!"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide cinematic shot under the full moon. Alexander towers over the three writhing thugs groaning in the mud as Juliana looks up from her knees.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up at Alexander, tears glistening on her mud-splattered cheeks in profound relief.

events.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Overwhelmed)
events.content: "Alexander..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot over Juliana's shoulder as Alexander turns his gaze toward her, his stern demeanor softening with concern.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle, Concerned)
events.content: "Are you hurt?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's trembling, soil-stained hands wrapped in blood-soaked bandages.

events.label: JULIANA (Fragile, Pain-filled)
events.content: "Only my hands."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Alexander suddenly wheels around, strides to the groaning Thug with Cap, and yanks him straight off the ground by his coat collar with one arm.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Demanding, Threatening)
events.content: "Who sent you?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Thug with Cap gagging under Alexander's iron fist.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Choking, Defiant)
events.content: "No one!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander, his eyes darkening with lethal fury.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Ominous)
events.content: "Wrong answer."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Roaring)
events.content: "Who?!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of the terrified thug gasping for air, his eyes bulging.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Screaming, Panicked)
events.content: "Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana on the ground, reeling in devastated disbelief as the betrayal hits her.

events.label: JULIANA (Shaken, Heartbroken)
events.content: "Gerald..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium wide shot as Alexander releases the thug, sending him tumbling into the ruined flowerbeds.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.

events.label: THUG WITH CAP (Shouting, Retreating)
events.content: "We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander's hand hanging by his coat. Fresh blood trickles from his split knuckles, and he slowly curls his fingers into a tight fist.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander flexes his bleeding hand, showing no sign of pain.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Juliana gingerly rises to her feet, stepping toward Alexander with deep awe and wonder in her eyes.

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Astounded)
events.content: "You knew exactly what to do."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, searching his scarred face.

events.label: JULIANA (Wondering, Intrigued)
events.content: "You fought like you've done this a hundred times."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Alexander turning his profile away, shadowed by haunted memories of his past.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Somber, Heavy-Hearted)
events.content: "A soldier learns things he wishes he could forget."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana softening with deep empathy as her eyes drop to his bleeding knuckle.

events.label: JULIANA (Tender, Concerned)
events.content: "Are you hurt?"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana reaches out toward his injured hand with delicate concern.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana standing face-to-face in the moonlit garden, framed against the dark night.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Steady)
events.content: "No."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander and Juliana gaze deeply into each other's eyes, an unspoken bond forming between them as the ruined garden lies silent beneath the moon.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Slow, resonant emotional cello melody swelling to a dramatic cliffhanger hold.
